subject: website
name: Beeport
summary: A Swarm postage-stamp and upload app, source public in ethersphere/beeport. It is not Level 3: its feedback widget injects the Formbricks SDK script from app.formbricks.com when the page mounts, third-party code the user did not ask for. It also reads chains and quotes from LI.FI and Relay, stamps from a Bee API and an indexer (The Graph), and uses public RPC endpoints.
